highlights: It is bought from Pingu's official online store in Japan, so you receive genuine Pingu merchandise.
Jute is a natural plant fiber, which gives the bag a relaxed, textured look.
The Jump design adds a lively Pingu character to a practical tote.
A tote bag is easy to load and carry, so it suits shopping trips and everyday outings.
A concierge checks the model, variant, stock and price before listing, so you can order with more confidence.

sections.p: Use it for shopping trips or as an everyday bag for your belongings. The jute material gives it a relaxed, natural feel.

It suits Pingu fans who like a natural-looking tote with a character design, and anyone choosing a gift. If you are looking for another size or design, our concierge can help through the request page.
